_description: Planning sheet for a chunking benchmark session. benchmark_runner.py does not read this file: it benchmarks the existing layout of one store per call, and --configs is only a label. Build one store per candidate (rechunking or synthetic-data skill), then run command_template once per candidate. dim_index values refer to the order of dims.

access_patterns._description: Map at one time step: fix time, read the y-x plane
access_patterns.name: spatial

access_patterns._description: Time series at one pixel: fix y and x, read the line along time
access_patterns.name: temporal

candidates._description: Spatial-optimized: large spatial dims, small time dim (16.8 MB float32)
candidates.name: c1x2048x2048

candidates._description: Temporal-optimized: large time dim, small spatial dims (16.4 MB float32)
candidates.name: c1000x64x64

candidates._description: Balanced: moderate size in all dimensions (52.4 MB float32)
candidates.name: c50x512x512

candidates._description: Fine-grained: smaller chunks for more parallelism (2.6 MB float32)
candidates.name: c10x256x256
